display.purpose: Page headings and the goal title. One per screen.

headline.purpose: The receipt heading and dialog titles.

numeral.purpose: Coin counts and rupee balance. Always tabular.

caption.purpose: Metadata and stat labels. The lightest text allowed.

shadows.name: shelf-lift
shadows.purpose: Every card in the Clay Shelf palette. Transparent shadow token in Ledger and Quiet.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Confirm and theme dialogs over the fixed dark scrim.

motion.name: bump
motion.purpose: The pot settling as a coin lands. Deliberate overshoot.

motion.name: glow
motion.purpose: Brass drop-shadow pulse on checkpoint and at 85% full.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Cards, dialogs, and phone toasts entering.

motion.name: coin-flight
motion.purpose: Web Animations API; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Pot level and checkpoint track width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud action per viewport: Deposit, Create Gullak, Spend.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-clay, #b5522d); color: var(--color-paper, #fffaf2); border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-clay-2, #9a4526); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #2a211c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Add mini-goal, See what you finished.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-cream-2, #efe5d5); color: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background: var(--color-line, #e4d8c6); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #2a211c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 44px circle for mute, theme, reorder, remove. Drawn stroke icon, never a glyph.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Remove"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-2, #6b5d53); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: var(--color-cream-2, #efe5d5); color: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #2a211c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Paper resting on the shelf. Hairline plus a soft offset shadow in Clay; flat in Ledger and Quiet.
components.html:
Run a marathon in 2 hours

150 / 320 coins
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-paper, #fffaf2); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4d8c6); border-radius: var(--radius-2xl, 1.75rem); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-shadow, rgba(42,33,28,.12)), 0 10px 24px -14px var(--color-shadow, rgba(42,33,28,.12)); color: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 18px/1.25 Fraunces, Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-num { margin: 6px 0 0; font: 700 24px/1 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-num span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-ink-3, #75675c); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Paper field with a hairline; glows clay on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Run a marathon in 2 hours" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--color-paper, #fffaf2); color: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e4d8c6); border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 1.25rem); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 16px/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--color-clay, #b5522d); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-3, #75675c); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-clay, #b5522d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-clay, #b5522d) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Pace Badge
components.description: Feedback, never guilt. Leaf ahead, sky on pace, terracotta behind, brass completed.
components.html: Ahead of pace On pace Behind pace
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font: 600 12px/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-ahead { background: var(--color-leaf-soft, #dceadf); color: var(--color-leaf, #3d6547); } .ds-badge-on { background: var(--color-sky-soft, #dbe5f1); color: var(--color-sky, #3b5c85); } .ds-badge-behind { background: var(--color-clay-soft, #f3d9cc); color: var(--color-clay-text, #9a4526); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Text pills; the current page is ink on cream.
components.html: GullaksWalletCompleted
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-item { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/1.4 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-2, #6b5d53); text-decoration: none; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-cream-2, #efe5d5); color: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); } .ds-nav-current, .ds-nav-current:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); color: var(--color-cream, #f6efe4); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: The word after the coin lands. Bottom-anchored; Undo variants hold 5s.
components.html:
+50 coins deposited
Removed Recovery run
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--color-ink, #2a211c); color: var(--color-cream, #f6efe4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.2); margin: 4px; } .ds-toast-undo { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(246,239,228,.15); color: inherit; padding: 4px 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-undo:hover { background: rgba(246,239,228,.25); }

narrative.overview: Gullak is a terracotta pot on a warm shelf. Everything on screen is the paper, wood, brass, and clay around that pot. The pot is the only illustration and the only progress indicator. By day the shelf is cream paper; by night the same shelf is lamp-lit, so dark mode changes paper and ink but never clay or brass. Two sibling worlds, The Childhood Ledger (ruled paper, ink blue, flat, squared) and The Quiet Piggy Bank (stone, fog, ash, almost no chroma), share every component and differ only in tokens. The user chooses on first launch and can change from the header.
keyCharacteristics: One illustration, the pot, drawn once and driven by a single number.
Two type families: Fraunces for display moments, Nunito for everything else.
Clay and brass are constant across all six palettes; paper and ink move.
Every text token clears 4.5:1 on its own surface.
One authored motion: coin leaves the button, arcs into the slot, the pot bumps, the sound lands.

rules.name: The Constant Clay Rule
rules.body: The pot is terracotta and the coin is brass in every palette and mode. Themes change the room, never the object.

rules.name: The One Loud Colour Rule
rules.body: Clay appears on at most one primary action per viewport.

rules.name: The Brass Means Earned Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only where coins have landed. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Fraunces on headings, goal titles, the balance, and dialog titles. Nunito does all the work.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading in small caps.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every coin count, rupee figure, date, and ratio uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry an offset and a blur. The only glow is the pot's brass pulse, and it is motion.

dos: Do let the pot be the only progress indicator.
Do keep the next deposit and its button inside the first phone viewport.
Do guard destructive actions with an in-app confirm or an undo toast.
Do keep every text token at or above 4.5:1 in all six palettes.
Do derive dates from local time and set numerals tabular.
Do use the shared classes and colour tokens; never a raw hex in a component.
Do scope new theme tokens under [data-palette] so picker previews stay live.
donts: Don't add a progress bar, ring, or percentage. The pot is the bar.
Don't put a small-caps label above a heading.
Don't use unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't change the pot's terracotta or the coin's brass in any palette.
Don't nest a bordered card inside a card.
Don't reward anything but a deposit.
Don't play a sound outside the deposit chain; always honour mute.
